summary: Enhance your skills in project scheduling and control for the oil and gas industry. Join our comprehensive training course and boost your career today!
lede: Project scheduling and control for oil and gas projects turns the schedule into a practical management tool for planning work, coordinating contractors, managing risk, and identifying deviations early. Learn to build realistic work breakdown structures, create logic-based schedules, integrate resources and costs, and track progress from concept and FEED through construction, commissioning, and shutdowns. Apply disciplined control to pipeline projects, tank farm expansions, refinery turnarounds, and offshore tie-ins. The course helps you manage slippage, site constraints, shutdown windows, HSSE requirements, and multi-discipline coordination while communicating project status clearly to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in planning, executing, and controlling oil and gas projects.
audience: Portfolio, program, or PMO leads in oil
modules: Fundamentals of Project Scheduling in Oil and Gas
Defining Scope and Building the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
Network Logic, Critical Path, and Dependencies
Schedule Risk, Scenarios, and Recovery Planning
Scheduling for Shutdowns, Turnarounds, and Brownfield Work
Reporting, Dashboards, and Communication of Schedule Status
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management principles and experience in the oil and gas sector. Familiarity with scheduling software like Primavera P6 or MS Project is beneficial.
